body.x: iGIS will exhibit its ICTsolution based on the geographic information system at CES 2019, the world'slargest technology exhibition held in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) toJanuary 11 (Fri).

iGIS (Innovative GIS) developedICT solution based on geographical information system. Currently, it isdeveloping spatial information service solution of central government andgovernment, and is actively developing and upgrading its own GIS solution (iGIS).

iGIS is available for severalusers with Concurrent License support at no additional cost and provides aneasy UI environment. It also provides schema auto-correction and additionaldevelopment support. In addition, it improves the efficiency of structuredediting due to its easy-to-use environment, and it is highly compatible withCAD, so structured editing is possible without going through various steps.
iGIS-Forest is an optimizedsolution for forestry operations. It is capable of performing all tasks relatedto forests and analysis, and has a design program for forest roads and roads.

iGIS-Drone is an easy-to-use,self-propelled drones for anyone, easy to link with the control system, easy todevelop, and easy to use for drones. In addition, iGIS-Mobile facilitates themaintenance of facilities (applies to general-purpose systems).

Meanwhile, Daegu Technopark, which participates inthe CES with local companies every year, will introduce 21 promising domesticcompanies in the upcoming 2019 CES. The 21 companies are available at the SouthPlaza Design & Source Showcase Zones in the showroom. Below are thecompanies that are participating in CES with support from Daegu TechnoparkMobile Convergence Center. ▲Intin ▲RF ▲LILLYCOVER ▲JJTech ▲3i ▲Falcon ▲GreenZone Security ▲Tech Inc. ▲Netblue ▲COBL ▲Daeyoung Chaevi ▲Second Ground ▲iGiS ▲Namgyeong ▲Joy Drone. These companies will also participate in the“MIK Night” event, hosted by AVING NEWS.
